title: Windows shell object created in vba — review required
description: CreateObject("WScript.Shell") gives the macro or script a Run and Exec surface. A command assembled from document content or a cell value becomes a program launch under the signed-in user. The rule flags the object creation; whether the command text is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Remove the WScript.Shell dependency; if a program must run, use a fixed command with validated parameters.
limitation: Lexical: matches the object creation; later Run calls are not linked.
